Performance, wellness, and injury recovery information by an orthopedic clinical specialist physical therapist. 

DISCLAIMER: The video content has been made available for informational and educational purposes only. It is general in nature and is not intended to be medical advice, nor does using it create a physical therapist-patient relationship with you.  Before starting, consult your own healthcare provider for a proper diagnosis and to ensure this content and any included products are safe and appropriate for your own medical and physical condition. Never disregard professional medical advice or delay in seeking it because of something you have read or seen on the Site. Unity Physical Therapy, PC and Dr. Shayan Safar make no representations about the accuracy or suitability of this content for you. By voluntarily using this content, you assume all risks for any resulting losses, injuries, or damages.
